partial_case.facts: The landlord was aware of a damp bedroom wall at the resident's property since November 2022. It inspected the wall and carried out some works over the next year. The resident complained to the landlord on 6 December 2023 as she said the wall was still damp.

key_reasoning_quotes.text: Following our intervention the landlord accepted that it had incorrectly calculated the compensation due to the resident for the loss of use of the bedroom. The landlord agreed to apologise to the resident, increase the overall compensation payment to £2,137 (including the revised figure of £1,228 for loss of use of the bedroom) and £150 additional compensation for its calculation error.
We are therefore satisfied that, following our intervention, the landlord has agreed to take actions to remedy matters which resolve the complaint satisfactorily.

claim_types: Complaint about the landlord’s handling of the resident’s reports of a damp bedroom wall
evidence: The landlord’s records showed it inspected the property and carried out some repairs after the resident reported the damp bedroom wall.
The landlord’s complaint responses apologised for delays and offered compensation.
partial_case.facts: The landlord was aware of a damp bedroom wall at the resident’s property since November 2022. The landlord inspected the wall and carried out some works over the next year. The resident complained to the landlord on 6 December 2023 because she said the wall was still damp. The complaint concerned the landlord’s handling of the resident’s reports of a damp bedroom wall.

recommendations: The landlord should apologise and make a payment of £2,137 to the resident.
The landlord may deduct £980.57 if already paid.
The landlord should arrange to inspect the damp wall and, if necessary, schedule repair works.

key_reasoning_quotes.text: The landlord’s records show it inspected the property and carried out some repairs to the damp bedroom wall after the resident had reported it.
Following our intervention the landlord accepted that it had incorrectly calculated the compensation due to the resident for the loss of use of the bedroom.
Both parties agreed to this as a resolution of the complaint.
We are therefore satisfied that, following our intervention, the landlord has agreed to take actions to remedy matters which resolve the complaint satisfactorily.
